description: Get the install details for one Illos illustration by its id. Use it after find_illustrations, once you have picked an id and need to add it; to search, use find_illustrations instead. A free illustration returns the React install command (shadcn), the SVG file's address for anything else, and the licence: free for commercial use, no credit. A Pro illustration returns its page, how to get Illos Pro, and the command for a machine signed in with Pro; it returns its install steps and, with include_svg, its SVG only when this server was connected with an Illos Pro key (Authorization: Bearer).

id.description: The id from find_illustrations, such as "notification-inbox" or "queue". The illustration's name works too.

include_svg.description: Also return the SVG markup (10 to 50 KB of text). Free illustrations, and Pro ones when connected with an Illos Pro key. Default false.

name: get_illustration
title: Get an illustration
